notes.title: HotFix 1.04
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who reported errors, in connection with them I took the trouble to make a bunch of edits:
- Rewrote the entire logic of sources, now the bug with the inability to drink water is gone.
- Fixed errors with achievements about the sun and the stick in NG+
- Death now starts the cycle again and does not throw you to the menu
- Minor change in the logic of jackals.
- Minor optimization of NG+

P.S. Big thx to Lentobombe and Olga 1987

notes.title: HotFix 1.02
notes.content:
Quick hotfix of the main problems
- Fixed a bug with the player spinning around his axis (Thanks to BlackUFA for finding it)
- The main storyline has been simplified even more.
- Added tips when dying, now you know how to play, little spoiler lovers
- Removed the Partisan Guardian, now he knows when to stop fighting... I guess
- Changed the tutorial a little, only the wording, to simplify the understanding of the gameplay.
